title: Joining Buddy Petit and work at the market and hotel
summary: Petit recruited Zardis; the band played the St. Bernard Market and a hotel with a following of white dance-givers across the lake.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: Yeah. So we did pretty nice. And all the while, and that's where Buddy come along then. Buddy would talk with me, you know, Buddy Manity. Buddy said, hey there. I said, I heard about you. I said, yeah, Mr. Buddy. I said, I'm doing pretty good. He said, how about you coming over with us? I said, well that'd be all right. I said, all right, so that's where I'll play that next job with them boys that Saturday. And I told them that I was going to go with Buddy Petit. All right, Buddy started getting jobs then at the St. Bernard Market. Buddy Petit was already with Buddy Man today. Yeah. Yeah. Them two been together before we did. And after that so we got the job at the market. Playing this for the opening tomorrow, you know, the people would come and buy stuff. And we played man for about two or three Saturdays. Well the job was paying more. I think we got three and a half or something. And we did all right. So after that so we decided after we played at that hotel, I can't think of that hotel. I think it was Centannomy Hotel up here. Might be. Yeah. Centannomy Hotel.

Well we used to work there. We worked there for a long time. And they had some old boys used to be around and they liked to follow us, some white boys, you know. And that group used to get together and give dances over there all the time. These keep us busy. And they used to keep us going, we used to go to Ponchatoula. They used to take us from Covenant and go to Ponchatoula.
